Don\'t know which quality to pick? Tap the \'✨ Eco\' button. It automatically analyzes your photo\'s resolution and complexity to find the \'Sweet Spot\'—the smallest possible size with no visible quality loss.
Easily find storage-hogging photos. Set a custom size (e.g., 5MB) and the app will scan your entire gallery. Select the \'hogs\' and shrink them all at once to reclaim GBs of space.

• Custom Watermark: Add your name or handle to the corner of every photo.
• Smart Batch Rename: Use patterns like 'Vacation_{n}' to save multiple photos sequentially. 

Note: If you set a name pattern here AND use the 'Before Compression' naming screen, the Naming Screen text will take priority. You can turn the naming screen off in Settings if you prefer only using patterns.
Check quality with pixel-perfect precision. Zoom or pan on either the \'Before\' or \'After\' photo, and the other one mirrors the movement perfectly. It\'s the best way to verify zero quality loss.
Clean your gallery by finding and removing duplicate or nearly identical photos. Reclaim space instantly.

MediaShrinker v10.0 • Made with ❤️ by Aaditya Shukla

Thank you for choosing MediaShrinker ❤️.

MediaShrinker is a high-performance utility built with a focus on privacy and efficiency. Please be assured that viewing the startup video does not consume cellular data. This application is designed to be fully secure, keeping your media processing entirely offline.

If you are interested in contributing to the project or have feedback, please reach out to the developer. Your support is deeply appreciated.

We recommend exploring the 'How to Use' section to familiarize yourself with our advanced features. Please feel free to report any bugs or suggest improvements directly to the development team.

Have a productive day!
Gratitude to those who supported this journey.
